needed.evidence: No continuous sidewalk; only a narrow, uneven dirt strip between the road edge and the buildings, with parked cars and debris encroaching on it.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous 1.5 m paved footway on the left, set back from the carriageway, to give pedestrians a safe place to walk.

needed.evidence: No proper sidewalk; a rough, unpaved strip runs along the road edge, partly taken up by parked vehicles and a metal gate.
needed.suggestion: Provide a continuous 1.5 m paved footway on the right, separated from the parking strip, so pedestrians are not forced onto the road.

needed.evidence: The narrow left strip is uneven, with loose material, a discarded object and an abrupt transition to the road.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the left footway to a smooth, even standard to remove the trip hazards.

needed.evidence: The right strip is rough and uneven, with debris and an irregular edge where it meets the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the right footway to a smooth, even standard to remove the trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Homes and shops line both sides creating crossing demand, but there is no marked or raised crossing in view.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with dropped kerbs at the point of highest demand to give a safe, visible place to cross.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along this urban stretch; only utility poles and overhead wires are present.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along both sides of the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers at night.
